policy.publication_rule: Do not publish a numeric observation until its source, reference period, retrieval timestamp, unit, transformation and revision status are recorded and validated.
policy.missing_data_rule: Use null with an explicit availability status; never replace missing source data with an estimate without a separately disclosed estimation method.

indicators.title: Реальный ВВП
indicators.method: Use the official real GDP volume index. Retain initial estimate and each subsequent revision as separate vintages.
indicators.publication_lag: As published by source; record actual release date.

indicators.title: Индекс потребительских цен
indicators.method: Store month-on-month and year-on-year measures as distinct series; do not infer one from the other without a documented calculation.
indicators.publication_lag: As published by source; record actual release date.

indicators.title: Ключевая ставка
indicators.method: Store effective-from and effective-to dates for each decision. For period averages, calculate day-weighted average and disclose the interval.
indicators.publication_lag: Decision date / effective date as published.

indicators.title: Промышленное производство
indicators.method: Preserve the published index and seasonal adjustment status; do not splice adjusted and unadjusted series.

indicators.title: Официальные курсы валют
indicators.method: Store currency, quote convention, effective date and nominal unit; period averages must be calculated from daily observations and labeled.
indicators.publication_lag: Daily publication schedule; record retrieval timestamp.

indicators.title: Экспорт товаров
indicators.method: Aggregate reported export values for a defined reporter, partner, period and HS classification. Retain trade flow, classification revision and reporting status.
indicators.publication_lag: As reported by national authorities; may be revised.

indicators.title: Импорт товаров
indicators.method: Aggregate reported import values for a defined reporter, partner, period and HS classification. Preserve CIF/FOB valuation basis where supplied.
indicators.publication_lag: As reported by national authorities; may be revised.

indicators.title: Сальдо торговли товарами

source.name: UN Comtrade
source.dataset: Derived from reported exports and imports

indicators.method: Exports minus imports only after aligning reporter, period, currency, HS scope and valuation convention. Flag non-comparable periods.

indicators.title: Концентрация товарных потоков

source.name: UN Comtrade
source.dataset: Derived from partner or product-level trade values

indicators.method: HHI = sum of squared percentage shares for a declared partner or product universe. Publish universe, missing-share treatment and whether shares are normalized.
indicators.publication_lag: Depends on completeness of source trade records.

indicators.title: Индекс продовольственных цен ФАО
indicators.method: Use the published FAO index and its stated base period. Do not relabel it as domestic retail inflation.
indicators.publication_lag: Monthly release schedule; record release date.

indicators.title: Производство и продовольственные балансы
indicators.method: Keep production, trade, stocks, food availability and dietary energy supply as distinct concepts and series.
indicators.publication_lag: Annual data may be published with a substantial lag and later revisions.

indicators.title: Установки промышленных роботов
indicators.method: Use annual installations, not the operational stock. Record country, industry classification and report vintage.
indicators.publication_lag: Annual; record report year and underlying observation year separately.

indicators.title: Плотность роботизации

source.name: IFR and ILOSTAT
source.dataset: Operational robot stock and manufacturing employment

indicators.method: Operational industrial robot stock divided by manufacturing employment, multiplied by 10,000. Record numerator and denominator vintages.
indicators.publication_lag: Depends on availability of both series.

indicators.title: Расходы на исследования и разработки

source.name: World Bank
source.dataset: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)

indicators.method: Use the published GERD-to-GDP indicator; retain source series code and revision date.
indicators.publication_lag: Annual; data availability varies by country.

indicators.title: Патентные заявки
indicators.method: Separate resident and non-resident applications, patent office and origin; do not combine national and PCT filings without explicit scope.

indicators.title: Использование интернета населением
indicators.method: Use the source definition and population denominator for each country-year; avoid mixing individuals using the internet with subscriptions.
indicators.publication_lag: Annual; report data year separately from release year.
